My dear [Sir](/person/1144),
I did not mean to publish the two volumes of the [History of Christian Names](/book/48) separately.[^1] The second is in a state of forwardness, but I thought I had explained when I saw you that I thought it would save time to have the 1st in the press while I am going over the 2nd again.
I imagine 2000 copies will be sufficient for a first edition.

My direction till the 20th will be the [Revd W Butler](/person/244)’s
						 Vicarage
							Wantage	
Yours faithfully
C.M.

Yonge


[^1]: It was published in two volumes by Parker, Son and Bourn in 1863.

This letter may perhaps have been addressed to [William Butler Bourn](/person/178) rather than the elder Parker.
